title: The Promise of Eternal Life
definition: The Promise of Eternal Life is God's gift of everlasting life to all who believe in Jesus Christ.
summary: The Promise of Eternal Life is God's assurance that those who believe in Christ will live with Him forever.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the resurrection and the life, giving eternal life to His sheep.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Eternal life is not merely endless existence; it is life in fellowship with God through Jesus Christ. The promise begins now and reaches fullness in the resurrection and the new creation. This doctrine fills salvation with future hope and present communion.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because suffering, death, and uncertainty can shrink a believer's horizon. Eternal life lifts the eyes to God's unbreakable promise in Christ. It also helps the Church speak hope that is stronger than sentiment at funerals, sickbeds, and seasons of grief.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let eternal life reshape your fears, priorities, and endurance. Comfort others with Christ's promise, not empty optimism. Live today as someone whose future is held by the risen Lord.
